description: Search public CVEs by text, risk signals and affected products. Vendor/product must be NVD CPE names; call find_product first. KEV is the strongest priority signal, then EPSS, then CVSS. A capped total is a lower bound.

kev.description: true: known-exploited only; false: exclude KEV; omitted: either.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1; capped at the API's maximum offset.

page_size.description: Results per page, default 10; clamped to 1–50.

product.description: Product CPE name, e.g. windows_server_2022; requires vendor. Call find_product first.

q.description: Web-style full-text search (quoted phrases, OR, exclusions), or an exact CVE ID.

ransomware.description: true: CISA ransomware-linked only; false/omitted: no ransomware filter.

since.description: Inclusive publication lower bound, ISO 8601 date/timestamp; dates use UTC midnight.

sort.description: Descending order: published (default), modified, cvss, epss or kev.

until.description: Inclusive publication upper bound, ISO 8601 date/timestamp; dates use UTC midnight.

vendor.description: Vendor CPE name, e.g. microsoft; call find_product first.

name: search_cves
